summary: Safety Portal Phase 1+2 backend fully verified (21/21 pytest pass on /api/safety/* + /api/admin/safety-users/*). Frontend login UI renders correctly with cyan-700 accent and required data-testids, but the post-login redirect to /safety-portal/change-password did not stick during automated runs — page returned to /safety-portal/login after submitting valid temp credentials. Hub home Safety Portal tile visibility not confirmed (test bailed during networkidle wait).

integration_issues.issue: After POST /api/safety/login with a fresh admin-issued temp password (must_change_password=true) and valid response, the browser briefly transitions (splash screen) and then ends up back on /safety-portal/login instead of staying on /safety-portal/change-password. Likely RequireSafety guard or EnforcePortalScope is clearing the masci.safety.token before /safety-portal/change-password mounts, OR the login page is not persisting the freshly-issued token to localStorage in time. The backend response itself is correct (verified via pytest test_old_token_rejected_after_change_password and TestAuth tests).

action_items: Investigate why the SafetyLogin → /safety-portal/change-password redirect does not stick. Verify (a) SafetyLogin.jsx writes masci.safety.token + masci.safety.user to localStorage BEFORE calling navigate('/safety-portal/change-password'), (b) EnforcePortalScope does not clear masci.safety.* when pathname starts with '/safety-portal/change-password' (this route IS under /safety-portal/* but may be hit at a moment when the scope effect runs first), (c) RequireSafety.jsx does NOT guard /safety-portal/change-password — that route should be reachable with just a valid token and must_change_password=true (not require fully-rotated session).
Re-run the SafetyHub KPI tile + safety-tile-ca presence test once the must_change flow is fixed.

Verify Hub home Safety Portal tile (data-testid=hub-section-safety-portal) renders with cyan accent in the Office Portals row when signed-out — partial screenshot showed home page but tile row was below the fold.
Verify /admin/people AdminSafetyUsersPanel manually (admin token + create temp pw reveal) — backend CRUD is fully validated, UI render was not exercised due to login flow blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/safety/forgot-password returns token_for_dev in production responses — convenient for preview but should be gated behind an explicit dev/preview flag before production deploy so Resend-issued reset links remain the single channel.

Backend admin reset-password endpoint always must_change=True with no body params — that's the intended behaviour and matches HR pattern, but unlike /api/admin/hr-users/{id}/reset-password it does not accept delivery=email|screen|custom — main agent may want parity for the AdminSafetyUsersPanel UI.

Corrective Action status transitions are NOT enforced server-side (any status can transition to any other via PATCH). If business wants strict Open→In Progress→Pending Review→Closed pipeline, server should reject illegal transitions; currently it relies on UI button visibility only.

/api/safety/overview computes incidents_last_7d via {'created_at': {'$gte': iso}} string comparison; ISO-8601 sorts lexically so it works, but recommend documenting/asserting created_at is always stored as iso8601 utc string across all 5 collections.
safety_users.py:38 imports _pm_hmac_secret (private helper) from pm_auth — cross-module private-symbol coupling; consider exposing a public hmac_secret() helper.

rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: (1) Admin POST /api/admin/safety-users/{id}/reset-password → captures temp_password. (2) Browser visits /safety-portal/login, fills email + temp pw, clicks Sign In. (3) Expected: navigate to /safety-portal/change-password. (4) Actual: brief splash, then back to /safety-portal/login. Backend login endpoint returns 200 + token + must_change_password=true correctly (proven by pytest). Suspect frontend timing issue in SafetyLogin.jsx — likely the navigate() runs before saveSafetyAuth() completes localStorage write, then RequireSafety mounts on /safety-portal/change-password with no token and bounces to /login. Fix: ensure saveSafetyAuth() (or equivalent token persistence) is awaited / called synchronously BEFORE navigate('/safety-portal/change-password'), OR allow /safety-portal/change-password to render unguarded when a valid token+must_change pair is present in localStorage.
